title: Maximum EMF
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the maximum electromotive force (200 V) using the formula E_m = nφ_mω, with correct values from the graph.

title: Instantaneous Current at 60°
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the instantaneous induced current (1 A) when the coil has rotated 60 degrees from t=0.

title: Voltmeter Reading
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the AC voltmeter reading (90√2 V) as the RMS voltage across the external resistor R.

title: Current Direction
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Lenz's law or the generator rule to determine the direction of the induced current (e.g., abcda) at the specified rotation.

title: Charge Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the formula q = nΔΦ/(R+r) to find the charge (0.02 C) passing through the coil during a 90° rotation.

title: Joule Heat Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the Joule heat (3.14 J) generated in the entire circuit for the relevant time interval, using RMS values or integration.

title: Angular Frequency Use
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly determine the angular frequency ω from the graph's period and use it in EMF and instantaneous value formulas.

title: RMS vs. Peak Confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student confuses RMS and peak values, e.g., using peak EMF for voltmeter reading or average power calculations.

title: Total Resistance Omission
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses only R or only r instead of the total resistance (R+r) in Ohm's law for the closed circuit.

title: Phase Error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses a sine function instead of cosine for the instantaneous EMF, given the initial condition (coil parallel to B at t=0).
